sentences.text:
THESE APPEALS COMING ON FOR CONCILIATION BEFORE LOK ADALAT, THIS DAY, THE FOLLOWING ORDER IS PASSED:
CONCILIATION ORDER
The learned counsel for the Appellant/Reliance Insurance Company Limited along with counsel for the respondents are present.
2. After prolonged negotiations, the matter is settled.

The Appellant/Reliance Insurance Company Limited has agreed to receive lump-sum amount of Rs.25,00,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Lakhs only), in full and final settlement of the claim, including Lower Court Award amount.
(Appellant Reliance Insurance Company Limited has already deposited of Rs.14,19,603/- deposited)
Total amount of Rs.14,19,603/- appellant has to deposit remaining amount of Rs.10,80,397/- only).

sentences.text: The order of apportionment and deposit ordered by the Tribunal shall hold good for the compensation awarded in this appeal.
4. In view of the settlement arrived in MFA No.202147/2022 filed by the insurance company, the MFA No.200479/2023 filed by the claimant/s is disposed off.

5. The appellant-Reliance Insurance Company Limited has agreed to deposit the said amount before the Tribunal within six weeks from the date of preparation of award, failing which the said amount shall carry interest at 9% p.a. from the date of default till the date of deposit.
The parties are not entitled for any cost.
A joint Memo is filed on behalf of the parties to this effect.
Same is accepted.
6. The Miscellaneous First Appeal stands disposed of in terms of the Joint Memo.
The award of the Tribunal shall stand modified accordingly.
Draw up the award accordingly.
